changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO jhi_resource_authority (id, verb, authority_id, resource_id) SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR RES_AUTH_SEQ, verbs.verb, auth.id, res.id FROM jhi_authority auth CROSS JOIN jhi_resource res CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('VIEW'), ('CREATE'), ('EDIT'), ('DELETE')) AS verbs(verb) WHERE auth.name = 'ROLE_ADMIN' AND res.name IN ( 'portability', 'timeFrame', 'undifinedStatus', 'setting', 'checkStatus', 'crmToCrdbResponseMap', 'businessConfig', 'offDay', 'portabilityLog', 'notificationTemplate', 'dayOfWeekTimeFrame', 'fileReportGenerationLog', 'eventLog', 'authority', 'resource', 'resourceAuthority' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jhi_resource_authority existing WHERE existing.authority_id = auth.id AND existing.resource_id = res.id AND existing.verb = verbs.verb );
